mapper.select: SELECT f.followID AS followId, u.userID AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.imgUrl AS avatarUrl, u.accountLevel AS accountLevel, u.fans AS fansCount, u.follows AS followCount, f.followDate AS followDate, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM follow f2 WHERE f2.followerID = u.userID AND f2.followedID = #{userId} AND f2.enable = 1) AS mutualFollow FROM follow f INNER JOIN `user` u ON f.followedID = u.userID WHERE f.followerID = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 ORDER BY f.followDate DESC
